inventory_scope_note: Branch locator includes 25 math and 74 FCP observed heads; topic routes are carefully selected high-value entry points, not exhaustive claim/theorem coverage.
source_of_truth: Original Git objects and exact CI run records remain authoritative; this is an overlay, not a merge or a new mathematical certificate.

status_model.LEAN_STRICT_QUALIFIED: Strict run checked for exact accepted theorem; do not expand scope.
status_model.HISTORICAL_STRICT_GATE_GREEN: Specific old strict workflow was verified green; inspect exact theorem/consumer/axioms before importing.
status_model.STAGED_SOURCE_ONLY_AT_HANDOFF: Original note reports source-only status at that time; reconcile later events.
status_model.STAGED_LEAN_CANDIDATE: Source exists and may contain useful technique; not independently strict qualified.
status_model.ANALYTIC_RESULT_NOT_LEAN_CERTIFIED: Analytical assertion, not verified by Lean.
status_model.RESEARCH_PROPOSAL_WITH_PARTIAL_QUALIFIED: Roadmap may link separate qualified results but does not itself prove proposed conclusions.
status_model.SOURCE_SCOPE_AUDIT_WITH_HISTORICAL_GREEN: Historical gate results with explicit scientific nonclaims.
status_model.HISTORICAL_GATE_NOTE: Notes about earlier qualification; verify source exactness.
status_model.CANONICAL_PROGRAM_ROUTING: FCP canonical program claims, not automatically BFSS Lean source proof.
